text_block_list.text: The day of the Kikuka Sho is here.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Райан talks about how countless
losses to
Мэдзиро МакКуин have pushed
her to grow strong
enough to compete
with her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, McQueen declares
that she
will run her hardest against
Ryan, who has
become a bona fide
contender in her eyes.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With their rivalry as intense as ever, the
two
racers head off to commence their
showdown.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
